description: This file implements internal functions and data structures for rendering commit graphs in a version control system, including handling of different graph states, column management, and output formatting.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit with its graph representation, handling different graph states and output formatting.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Displays a single-line representation of a commit with its graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs a padding line in the graph, used for spacing.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs remaining lines of the graph after the main commit display.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Displays the commit message along with its graph, handling continuation if needed.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the width of the current graph output for layout purposes.
